annotations.title: Live WanBridge custody, the Bridge Solvency tab

description: Live WanBridge custody against bridge-issued supply: the figures behind the Bridge Solvency tab on orbitwan.io/data. scope majors (default) answers the major assets, their EVM sites re-read every minute and other sites every 5 minutes; scope all answers every asset of the newest recorder run, written every 5 minutes. Each component carries state (COMPLETE, FLOOR, UNREADABLE, NO_LIABILITY), custody_raw, liability_raw, ratio (COMPLETE only), ratio_floor (FLOOR only: a lower bound, never the true ratio), worst_case, verified and first_verified_at. The tab lists an asset only once it has been verified (a full ratio or a lower bound at or above 1, with the worst case holding) and keeps it listed after. symbol filters to one asset; include_sites, with symbol only, adds its sites chain by chain (address, value, block). Observations only.
